Which KJV verse each Hebrew verse sits beside was worked out with the help of the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible (github.com/openscriptures/morphhb), CC BY 4.0: "Original work of the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible available at https://github.com/openscriptures/morphhb".
